    Kernels and the path-length filtration #

    A linear realization of a free path category has no kernel terms below a cutoff when the short realized paths remain linearly independent modulo a target submodule containing every long realized path. The cutoff-two case is the generic linear-algebra step in ordinary-quiver admissibility.
